searchText: where can i find the code for the proof of stake algorithm ? i want to study how it is implemented in Ethereum In nimbus, the entry point is https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/blob/unstable/beacon_chain/fork_choice/fork_choice.nim#L366 - from there, you will find plenty of links to specifications, performance analysis etc thanks! so basically we check the code of consensus clients! i assume i can try similar with lighthouse (should i inquire in the lighthouse discord) indeed, every client has an implementation - the canonical source is the spec: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.1/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md thanks you are amazing! can someone point me to where the attestation changes for electra are being discussed?
